test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Six friends (Aman, Biplab, Chirantan, Divya, Elizabeth and Firoz) are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Aman sits third to the left of Biplab. Chirantan is an immediate neighbour of Aman. Elizabeth sits second to the right of Divya. Chirantan is not an immediate neighbour of Divya. Who sits between Biplab and Firoz?
solution:
The sitting arrangement as per the given information:

1. Aman sits third to the left of Biplab.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/004b07e87bf133b4068b018b8df139fb38737b6ec0308e0594e6bdecaf6e3245.png] 

2. Chirantan is an immediate neighbour of Aman.

**Case 1:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40f3e90caf7f86593abb79d5fa51a2c835f26036a89d33508caff78ec6016521.png] 

**Case 2:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dffe1d225d6732f5e0711f010e9374075e379663ad28f492b7f539d7aa4faa94.png] 

3. Elizabeth sits second to the right of Divya and Chirantan is not an immediate neighbour of Divya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9afddeaac3727e91ffe4a31d5f772c707cd39d8c555273ed5b894f019ef5ef1b.png] 

4. The remaining person Firoz is sitting to the left of Divya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9971ae6a2f6c635bdc0768d63ba591c87be3edb3e4f774e6b138fa56ae4c3c7.png] 

Here, 'Divya' is sitting between Biplab and Feroz.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Divya"**.
